bodyHtml:
💻 Fixed-Price Screen Quotes · Logan & Surrounds

Laptop Screen Replacement Logan. Cracked, Flickering Or Dead, Fixed Fast.

Dropped your MacBook, lines across your ASUS panel, or a Dell touchscreen refusing to light up? Computer Repairs Logan supplies and fits genuine or high-grade OEM screens for every major laptop brand, with rapid workshop turnaround across Logan.

Replace My Screen
✓ Brand-Matched Parts
✓ Same-Day For Common Models
✓ 12-Month Part Warranty
✓ Afterpay & ZipPay Available
Why Choose Us

Why Choose Computer Repairs Logan For Screen Replacement.

🖥️

Brand-Matched Parts

Genuine LCD, LED or IPS panels for Apple, HP, Lenovo, Dell, ASUS, Acer and Surface devices.

⏱️

Same-Day Installation

Common models (13- and 15-inch Full HD) swapped within two hours, turnaround depends on the exact model and spec.

💰

No-Surprise Pricing

An up-front quote includes part, labour, pickup and return, no call-out add-ons.

📜

12-Month Part Warranty

Defects or dead pixels? We replace it free of charge.

🧼

Anti-Static, Dust-Free Bench

Clean install, hinges checked and serviced as part of the job.

🎨

Colour-Accurate Upgrades

Optional 100% sRGB calibration add-on for designers and photo/video editors.

Common Screen Faults We Fix

Recognise Any Of These?

💥

Cracks & Shattered Glass

From corner drops or hidden pressure points.

📊

Vertical / Horizontal Lines

Ribbon-cable or panel failure.

🌑

Dim Or No Backlight

Inverter or LED strip burnout.

🌈

Flicker / Colour Inversion

Ageing CCFL or a failing T-Con board.

Brands We Work With

Don't See Your Exact Model?

We source panels for around 95% of laptops on the Australian market, including legacy machines and niche gaming brands: Apple MacBook, Lenovo ThinkPad/IdeaPad/Legion, Dell XPS/Inspiron/Latitude, HP Pavilion/Envy/Spectre/EliteBook, ASUS ZenBook/VivoBook/ROG, Acer Swift/Aspire/Nitro, Microsoft Surface, Razer Blade, Samsung, LG, MSI and more. Just give us the model number in your quote request and we'll confirm price and availability within one business hour.

Typical Pricing

14 to 15" IPS Panel Replacement

$195, $265 / all-inclusive
  • Part, labour, pickup and return
  • 12-month warranty included
  • MacBook Pro Retina assembly: $599, $799 depending on size
  • OLED upgrade on supported models: +$140
  • BlueShield™ anti-glare overlay: +$25
Frequently Asked Questions

Laptop Screen Replacement Questions, Answered.

What does a typical cracked laptop screen fix cost?

For most 1920×1080 IPS panels (Acer Swift, ASUS VivoBook, Lenovo IdeaPad and similar) the all-inclusive price ranges $195, $265. That covers part, labour, pickup/return and a 12-month warranty.

Can you offer same-day screen repair?

If we have your panel in stock (common Dell XPS, HP Pavilion or MacBook Air models), we can often finish onsite within 2 hours of arrival. Less common models may need to be sourced first.

Do you replace the full MacBook Pro screen assembly or just the glass?

Current Retina models are one-piece assemblies, we fit genuine Apple parts. Typical cost is $599, $799 depending on size.

My screen shows no image but the backlight still glows, can you fix that?

Yes, this "no display but backlight works" symptom is usually a failed LCD or T-Con board. A panel replacement restores the picture.

Is touchscreen digitiser replacement included for 2-in-1 laptops?

Yes, Surface Laptop, HP Spectre x360 and Dell Inspiron touch assemblies are stocked, and the quoted price covers the digitiser and LCD together.

Can I upgrade to OLED from IPS on supported models?

In most cases yes, ask for an OLED screen replacement quote. Expect roughly +$140 on top of standard IPS pricing.

What is your dead-pixel policy?

Any stuck or bright pixel spotted within 14 days triggers a free swap under our dead-pixel replacement promise.

Will a screen swap void my manufacturer warranty?

No. We use brand-matched parts and document serial numbers, so your remaining manufacturer warranty stays intact.

Can you provide an insurance quote for laptop screen damage?

Sure, a written PDF quote with part number, labour and GST so you can lodge a claim with Suncorp, NRMA, RACQ or any other insurer. See our insurance reports service for full damage reports.

Is Afterpay or ZipPay available?

Both, choose pay-in-4 at checkout for repairs over $300, handy for MacBook and OLED jobs.

What if the screen fails again within 12 months?

Rare, but covered, we replace the panel and labour free, no shipping fees, no excuses.

Related Services

Screen Sorted, Anything Else Playing Up?

While the laptop's open, it's a good time to check the battery health or address any loose hinges, we offer complimentary hinge-tightening during a screen swap. For any other fault, see our general laptop repairs page, or Apple Mac repairs if it's a MacBook.

Get My Fixed-Price Screen Quote.

Enter your laptop model and we'll have a binding quote back to you within one business hour.

Replace My Screen
